svg.text: NI MULTISIM COMPLETE CIRCUIT SCHEMATIC: AUTOMATIC WATER-LEVEL CONTROLLER
GM UNIVERSITY | DEPT OF ECE | COURSE: UE25EC3502 (LINEAR INTEGRATED CIRCUITS WITH PRACTICE) | BREADBOARD & SIMULATION MASTER NETLIST
Basic > SWITCH > SPDT / SPST | Interactive Hotkeys: [L] and [H]
Basic > RELAY > RELAY_SPDT (12V Coil) | Transistors > BJT_NPN > BC547B

g.text: Series: 330 Ω ballast tied to 555 Pin 3
Triggered when LM358 Pin 7 outputs HIGH
LM358 Pin 3 (Schmitt In) | Measures low probe dry/wet level
LM358 Pin 1 (Schmitt Out) | Verifies 78 mV hysteresis snap-action
NE555 Pin 6/7 (Timing RC) | Observes 5.17s anti-slosh blanking ramp
NE555 Pin 3 (Relay Output) | Drives BC547B saturated switch
Timebase: 1.0 s/Div | Y-Scale: 2.0 V/Div | Trigger: CH B Edge

svg.text: Press F5 in Multisim, then toggle keys [L] and [H] to simulate filling/draining
